title: Premature Attraction of Pollinators to Inaccessible Figs of Ficus altissima: A Search for Ecological and Evolutionary Consequences
screening_reason: Single fresh pollinators were experimentally introduced into monoecious figs on days 1-5 after accessibility; seeds and pollinator offspring were counted in the same figs. Seed production peaked on days 2-3 rather than day 1, giving direct mixed-system interior-peak shape evidence, but group means/uncertainty needed for a formal quadratic effect are not reported in text.
notes: Ficus altissima × Eupristina altissima. Source Poisson GLM across days 1-5: seed beta=-0.09±0.01; pollinator offspring beta=-0.16±0.01; n=27,25,24,23,21. Admit to preregistered H2 shape lane, not strict-H1 slope because the source itself states an interior seed peak.
